subModules.title: Basic Air Navigation
subModules.description: Navigate using TACAN, INS, and visual references. Demonstrate accurate fix-to-fix navigation and fuel planning on a cross-country sortie.

subModules.title: Instrument Procedures
subModules.description: Fly partial-panel approaches, holds, and SIDs/STARs in IMC conditions. Demonstrate ILS and TACAN approach to minimums.

subModules.title: Emergency Procedures
subModules.description: React correctly to simulated engine failures, hydraulic failures, and fire warnings. Demonstrate correct checklist usage and decision-making under pressure.

subModules.title: Basic Gunnery
subModules.description: Demonstrate air-to-air and air-to-ground gun employment. Achieve a minimum 15% hit rate in a strafe pass and one valid snapshot opportunity in a turning engagement.

subModules.title: A/G Unguided Weapons
subModules.description: Employ unguided iron bombs, rockets, and CBUs against point and area targets. Demonstrate correct dive and laydown attack profiles.

subModules.title: A/G Guided Weapons
subModules.description: Employ laser-guided and GPS-guided munitions. Demonstrate correct laser-lasing procedures, stand-off employment, and post-release terminal guidance.

subModules.title: BVR A/A Employment
subModules.description: Demonstrate radar search, lock, and BVR missile employment against a non-manoeuvring and manoeuvring target. Correct Rmax/NEZ/Rpi awareness required.

subModules.title: Formation Flying
subModules.description: Fly fingertip, route, and tactical spread formations. Demonstrate correct join-up, position maintenance to ±50ft, and safe break/rejoin procedures.

subModules.title: CAS Procedures
subModules.description: Execute a 9-line CAS brief from a JTAC, correctly identify and attack the assigned target, and pass a BDA. Demonstrate correct abort criteria awareness.

subModules.title: SEAD/DEAD Operations
subModules.description: Demonstrate correct threat identification, ARM employment, and suppression timing in coordination with a strike package. Correct deconfliction from escort required.

subModules.title: Radio Procedures
subModules.description: Demonstrate correct radio discipline: callsign usage, correct read-back, freqency management, and stepping on air to ground/ground to air comms.

subModules.title: ATC & IFR Operations
subModules.description: Communicate correctly with virtual ATC on all phases of flight: pushback, taxi, departure, en-route, approach, and landing. Correct ATIS decode required.

subModules.title: Tactical Brevity
subModules.description: Use correct NATO BREVITY code words during a multi-ship tactical scenario. Assessed on BULLSEYE reporting, threat calls, and flight lead communications.
